Assalaamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, Dear Sheikh, I pray to Allah SWT that you are enjoying a good health & high Islamic spirit. (1) It has come to my knowledge that some people observe certain nawwafil salaah by reciting any specific surah a certain number of times( that is more than once) in each raka'ah after reading surah faati'ha. Sometimes they would make an extra sajdah after reading the tashahhud & darood and there, they would ask for any specific doah they are in need for. They would even call this salah as haajaat. However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. (2) My second question is about those 'aamil who after asking someone's name & mother's name, claim that they make istikhaarah salah in order to find out if that person is under the influence of jiin or evil eyes etc. As far as i understand, Istikhaarah salaah is accomplished when someone is unsure of whether doing something is good for him/her or not. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? I look forward to your valuable views and comments on the above two issues Incha Allah. I thank you in anticipation for your cooperation. Wassalaam. 2469 views Q. I have been married since 3 years. answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 33228 Country: United Kingdom Title: My problem is that I have got pain in my neck, due to it my neck pulls towards right hand side. Question: My problem is that I have got pain in my neck, due to it my neck pulls towards right hand side. I have done scan but nothing was shown. I went to an Alim he said I have 3 problems, jinn, jadu and nazar, but now he is saying everything is clear but the jinn left the pain. It happened 2 and half years ago, when I came from holiday from Africa, until then I was a very healthy person. Could you please help me? Answer ID: 33228 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1107/933/B=1432) Get some water blown after reading Manzil by any pious person and drink it for forty days, as well as sprinkle the water for seven days after sunset all over your home. Recite Muawwazatain once after each salah and blow over you. Also keep on supplicating Almighty Allah for your health. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
